embeds.title: ARTICLE VIII — LINEUPS AND GOALIE STARTS
embeds.description:
Lineups are set daily. Managers are responsible for maintaining legal rosters and active lineups.

A franchise may receive credit for a maximum of:

• **4 goalie starts** during a normal fantasy week
• **8 goalie starts** during the two-week championship period

Fantrax enforcement settings govern the technical application of these limits.
